source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بحديقة بيتنا، عشش عصفور صغير عالشجرة.
sentences.en: In our house garden, a little sparrow nested in the tree.

sentences.ar: كل الصبح، كان يصحينا بغناه الحلو.
sentences.en: Every morning, it would wake us with its beautiful singing.

sentences.ar: الولاد كانوا يحطولوا فتات خبز ومي.
sentences.en: The kids would put out bread crumbs and water for it.

sentences.ar: صار العصفور يعرفنا وما يخاف مننا.
sentences.en: The sparrow came to know us and wasn't afraid of us.
Once, a strong storm blew at night.
In the morning, we found the nest had fallen to the ground.

sentences.ar: الولاد زعلوا، وخافوا إنه العصفور مات.
sentences.en: The kids got upset, and feared the sparrow had died.
But we found it standing on the branch, safe.

sentences.ar: جمعنا العش وحطيناه بمكان أعلى وأأمن.
sentences.en: We gathered the nest and put it in a higher, safer place.
The sparrow returned to it, as if thanking us.

sentences.ar: بعد أسابيع، طلعت من العش عصافير صغيرة.
sentences.en: After weeks, little sparrows emerged from the nest.

sentences.ar: الولاد فرحوا كأنه في مواليد جداد بالعيلة.
sentences.en: The kids were as happy as if there were new babies in the family.
We watched them until they grew and learned to fly.

sentences.ar: يوم، طاروا كلهم، وضل العش فاضي.
sentences.en: One day, they all flew away, and the nest stayed empty.

sentences.ar: بس كل ربيع، بيرجع عصفور يعشش بنفس الشجرة.
sentences.en: But every spring, a sparrow comes back to nest in the same tree.
